_comment: Every value a report control in the UI can send the server. One list, two languages: frontend/src/components/reports/charts/reportControls.test.ts holds reportControls.ts to it, and backend/tests/integration/test_report_scope.py sends each value and requires a 200. The server's bounds (ProjectionDays, PaydayWindow, ReportLimit, AnomalyThreshold) were tested only at their defaults, so tightening one to the default would 422 the other options with every test green. MAX_REPORT_MONTHS records this repo shipping exactly that once.
